facts.fact: The agricultural investment promotion agency APIA announced that from 1 July 2026 the digital identity (Mobile ID) is used to obtain the investment declaration certificate, and applicants must obtain one.

TechAfrica News reports the Tunisia Investment Authority made Mobile ID mandatory for all investment project declarations from 1 July 2026, so investors must hold a Mobile ID digital identity to access investment declaration services.

The Registre National des Entreprises states that from 1 July 2026 all its procedures are online only and access requires a digital identity, Mobile ID for natural persons and DigiGO for legal persons.

The author states E-Houwiya serves as single sign-on for government portals including E-Bawaba, E-CNAM, E-People, E-CNSS and Madrassati, and is linked to the national ID number.
The author describes E-Houwiya as used in banking (onboarding, wire transfers) and in government portals, including E-CNAM, E-CNSS and Madrassati.
